Subsetting a reference frame gives a plain data frame.

Source: R/calibrate.R
sub-.gr_reference_frame.Rd

[ on an object whose class extends data.frame keeps the CLASS and drops every other attribute, so ref[, cols] came back still claiming to be a gr_reference_frame while of, frame_n, screened_n and seed were gone, and gr_calibrate() then computed the corpus-wide metric set from a stratified sample. The same trap, and the same fix, as [.gr_gaps.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gr_reference_frame'
x[...]

Arguments

x

A gr_reference_frame.

...

Passed to the data frame method.

Value

A plain data frame.
